title: Exact Ionization Amplitudes for a Delta-Function Well in an Arbitrary-Strength DC Electric Field
summary: We investigate finite-time field-induced ionization from a one-dimensional attractive delta-function well in a uniform dc electric field of arbitrary strength. Our aim is to determine the physical bound-state survival amplitude \(a_b(t)\) at any observation time without constructing the complete time-dependent propagator or wavefunction. In the gauge-equivalent Kramers--Henneberger representation, the field appears as motion of the contact point, and the resulting dynamics reduces to a closed Volterra equation.
